title: Zuma — zk Yuma consensus
intro: A subnet where nobody knows who is who. Miners and validators each prove they belong to their group without saying which member they are, so a validator can't favour a friend and a miner can't court a validator. Scores stay sealed until everyone has locked in, then Yuma pays what the majority agrees on and cuts back anyone who over-rates a miner.
steps: The owner adds miner and validator keys (Add member). Keys are made on the member's own machine: m zkworld.zuma/keygen name=me role=miner.
Miners hand in work anonymously: m zkworld.zuma/submit name=me work=... Each shows up under a fresh tag every round.
Validators lock in one score per tag: m zkworld.zuma/commit name=me weights=4,3,2,1, then reveal once everyone has locked in.
Anyone presses Run consensus. Each member then claims its share to any address it likes: m zkworld.zuma/claim name=me epoch=0 to=0x...

constructor.help: Smallest crowd a member may hide in, how long each stage lasts (seconds; a stage also ends early once everyone is in), and how much is paid out each round.

phase.label: Stage (0 hand in, 1 lock in, 2 reveal, 3 ready to run)

finalize.label: Run consensus
finalize.help: Runs Yuma over the opened scores and starts the next round.

register.label: Add member
register.help: Owner only, and only before a round starts. Group 1 = miner, 2 = validator. Validators need a stake; members can only hide among others with the same stake.

Submitted.say: An anonymous miner handed in work in round {epoch} (hiding among {ring_size})

Sealed.say: An anonymous validator locked in scores for round {epoch} (hiding among {ring_size})

Revealed.say: A sealed score was opened in round {epoch}
